description: Phase B fixup — regression guard for the manual-resume unstick. After auto-pause at a section break, hitting Play (NOT SectionGo) resumes playback past the break. The next break-detection cycle MUST clear the at-break latch — otherwise a subsequent SectionGo would seek backward to the previous break. This test asserts the latch is gone after manual play by playing past the first break and crossing into a region where SectionGo would visibly misbehave if the latch were still set.
